migration.name: 20261007130000_queue_snapshot_held_and_process_share
migration.backfill: None in SQL: three nullable columns, added with IF NOT EXISTS. Existing rows read NULL, which is exactly what a queue that never records holds reports. The Workroom stage history is replayed by the queue aggregator's one-time, idempotent drive-log replay, not by the migration.
migration.rollback: Forward-only. Older code ignores the new columns; rollback means reverting the code, never dropping the columns.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Existing model; new columns follow the row's lifecycle and add no retention obligation.

fields.reason: Median held time (waiting on a person or blocked) of items finished in the window, computed from QueueTelemetryEvent held/released spans.
95th percentile of the same held time.
Sum of process time over sum of cycle time for items finished in the window: the queue's flow efficiency.
